headline.text: L3 completed Level 2 weekend clean with *zero* ATP failures — all quality, sensory, and sanitation checks passed across production.

summary: Clean FSQA window. L3 Truffle line ran through second and third shifts with all organoleptic inspections, weight checks, and packaging verifications meeting spec. Level 2 post-operational cleaning completed overnight with all ATP tests passing. No holds, no food-safety flags, no quality deviations.
